events.text: Russia has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God of the Vine (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each [ICON_RES_WINE] Wine, [ICON_RES_BEER] Beer, and [ICON_RES_COGNAC] Cognac resource)
